correctness.rationale: Constant modulus is supplied by the sharp published theorem. Equality in generic-fiber Cauchy--Schwarz gives the centered-triple functional equation. The explicit bridge fills the split isotropic directions. The resulting midpoint character law forces a constant second multiplicative difference on the cyclic prime field, hence a quadratic phase. Quadratic phases are sufficient by physical translation symmetry. Finite computations only corroborate the proof.
